scope: 84 unchanged binary/Koblitz m3..9 original/baseline/spike40 systems; original-top exact regularity via overlap proof with native checked hypotheses; independent review pending

files.certificates/global.json: Rabin proof; full83 Moore inverse; all83 cyclic selector-window inverse pairs for each base; all83 first/middle cubic embedding coefficient hashes

encodings.field: Unsigned DECIMAL strings represent coefficients by bits in K=F2[z]/(z^83+z^45+z^2+z+1); parse exact integers
encodings.modulus_hex: HEX bit polynomial includes leading degree83 bit
encodings.matrix: Rows are weight_i^(2^k), all83 embeddings. Cyclic window start uses rows start..start+ell-1 modulo83; inverse is stored and both products checked.
encodings.coordinate_equation_coefficients: 83 decimal K scalars combine source coordinate equations r=0..82 in a single chain group
encodings.coefficient_u128le_sha256: SHA256 of verified coefficients as16-byte little-endian integers in lexicographic Cartesian product order; for quadratic embedding proofs order is abstract product basis1,z,...,z^82
encodings.blocks: start_zero_based and width specify original variables; Singular v(i) is one-based
encodings.chain_equation: Zero-based S3 group; its coordinate r has one-based I[83*k+r+1]
encodings.top_counts: Number of canonical highest-degree monomials in each coordinate; every actual coefficient checked and expected support count matched
encodings.p0_scale: c_k=t^(2^k-1) for nonzero t; P_k+c_k*P_0 equals stored original-quadratic combination
encodings.lower_retained_variables: Projection retains first27 base selectors plus all83(m-2) intermediate variables
encodings.upper_bound: n(m-2)+ell+1 under conditions n>=2ell,n>=ell+2, same independent F2-linear selector weights; written algebraic bridge in CHAIN_EXACT_DESIGN.md
encodings.hashes: SHA256 over exact file/line bytes; source_line_sha256 excludes line-ending newline
encodings.old_fields: selected_chain_equations_zero_based and selected_variables_zero_based preserve the prior disjoint proof only. They are not the new overlap calculation.

claims_not_made: Full original Hilbert functions at n83
replay: Extract complete raw archive to a fresh root; sha256sum -c manifest.sha256; instrument replay ROOT; recheck manifest. Never run producer into an existing root.
